title: Expense Agent: Mobile Experience (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Expense Agent mobile app
Key capabilities: receipt capture, no license requirement, offline mode
Mobile feed view and expense details
Agent extraction and itemization, expense modification
Receipt scanning with native OS capabilities

features.name: Expense Agent mobile app
features.description: A mobile application for iOS and Android that allows employees to capture receipts on their smartphones without requiring a Business Central license. The app uses AI to extract expense details automatically.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained

features.name: Receipt capture with native OS detection
features.description: Mobile app uses native OS capabilities to detect receipt edges, apply brightness adjustments, and optimize image quality for AI processing even when receipts are bent or poorly lit.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained

features.name: Social feed view for expenses
features.description: Unlike the web app which groups expenses into reports, the mobile app displays expenses in a social media-style feed where each expense is listed individually with the ability to scroll and view details.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained

features.name: AI extraction of expense details
features.description: The agent automatically extracts total amount, date, description, payment means, category, and itemized line items from receipt images.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained

features.name: Inline expense modification
features.description: Users can modify all extracted expense details directly in the mobile app before submitting to Business Central.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained

features.name: Itemization tab for line items
features.description: A dedicated tab in the mobile app showing all line items from the original receipt with details such as date, subcategory, quantity, and rate.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained

features.name: Receipt sharing from OS photo library
features.description: Users can share expense receipts directly from their device's native photo library to the Expense Agent app using OS-level sharing capabilities.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained

features.name: Offline expense capture
features.description: Employees can scan and capture receipts while offline, with the app queuing them for processing once internet connectivity is restored and the app reconnects to Business Central.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained
caveats: Processing does not occur until the app is back online

features.name: No Business Central license required
features.description: Mobile app users do not need a Business Central license to capture and submit expenses; the app integrates directly with Business Central for processing.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can expect this new preview mode very soon as Claudio explained

features.name: iOS and Android support
features.description: The Expense Agent mobile app is available for both iOS and Android platforms.
features.status_evidence_quote: but of course, we also do support iOS and we are planning to release it to you very soon
caveats: The demo focused on Android; iOS support exists but not separately demonstrated

quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the design philosophy behind the mobile app: bringing expense capture to where employees naturally work, on their phones.

quotes.text: You don't need Business Central license the same as the for web app. Everything will be integrated automatically in the Business Central
quotes.why_it_matters: Key capability: mobile users do not require BC licenses, and the app integrates seamlessly with BC for backend processing.
